about: Every external figure the cost case uses, with its source. Nothing in the white paper is typed — the kernel (src/office.mjs) computes from this file and data/office.json. Checked 2026-10-14 unless noted; entries marked 'via estate basis' were sourced in fallfloor-enterprise/prices.lock.json on 2026-09-29/30.
currency: GBP, ex-VAT (a VAT-registered business reclaims VAT on hardware; SaaS seats are quoted ex-VAT)

wageMedianHourly.what: ONS ASHE 2025: median hourly earnings excluding overtime, full-time employees, UK

seniorSalary.what: ONS ASHE 2025 Table 14.7a, median gross annual pay, full-time, SOC 2132 IT managers — used for every senior / AI-native lead role

employerNiRate.what: Employer Class 1 National Insurance above the secondary threshold, 2026 to 2027

employerNiThreshold.what: Secondary threshold, 2026 to 2027 (£96 a week, £417 a month, £5,000 a year)

pensionEmployerRate.what: Automatic enrolment: minimum employer contribution on qualifying earnings

cpi.what: UK CPI, 12 months to August 2026 — applied every year to pay, seats and electricity

electricityPencePerKwh.what: UK non-domestic electricity incl. Climate Change Levy, Q2 2026 (DESNZ Quarterly Energy Prices, Sept 2026)

fxGbpPerUsd.what: ECB reference rates 2026-09-28 (GBP 0.85785 / USD 1.1378 per euro)

voicePerMinute.product: ElevenLabs conversational AI agents (Business, per-minute rate; the agent's language model runs on our own models)

aiBox.product: NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB unified memory, 4 TB)
aiBox.priceNote: current UK listing (launch price was about £3,700 at Scan / Novatech; we use the higher current figure)
aiBox.throughputNote: LMSYS, SGLang: aggregate decode 368 tokens/s at batch 32, prefill ~7,950 tokens/s

hub.product: Apple Mac mini, M4 Pro (12-core CPU, 24 GB, 512 GB)

laptopExtraWatts.what: Intel Core i7-1255U Processor Base Power — the extra draw of in-browser AI on a laptop already in use

awsGpuLondon.product: AWS EC2 p5.4xlarge (1 x NVIDIA H100 80 GB HBM3, 16 vCPU, 256 GiB), Linux on-demand, EU (London) — the dedicated cloud GPU that runs the same open-model class as the AI box

bedrockGptOss120b.product: Amazon Bedrock — OpenAI gpt-oss-120b, Standard on-demand, EU (London)
bedrockGptOss120b.via: AWS Price List API, published 2026-10-14, read 2026-10-14 (EUW2-gpt-oss-120b-input-tokens $0.00023 / output-tokens $0.00093 per 1K)

hoursPerYear.what: an always-on service: 24 hours x 365 days

redundancy.what: UK statutory redundancy pay: half a week's pay per full year of service under 22, one week from 22 to 40, one and a half weeks from 41; service capped at 20 years; weekly pay capped at £751 for redundancies on or after 6 April 2026 (maximum £22,530); needs 2 years' service

statutoryNotice.what: Statutory minimum notice: one week between one month and two years' service; one week per full year from 2 to 12 years; 12 weeks at 12 years or more

collectiveConsultation.what: 20 or more redundancies at one establishment within 90 days: consult for at least 30 days (20–99) or 45 days (100+) before the first dismissal, and notify the Redundancy Payments Service on form HR1 before consultation starts

discountRateReal.what: HM Treasury Green Book Social Time Preference Rate: 3.5% in real terms for years 1 to 30 of an appraisal — combined here with CPI to discount cash flows that rise with inflation
